numeral.purpose: Coral section number in the right margin.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked nav links, greeting, and section labels.

shadows.name: none-at-rest
shadows.purpose: Swiss sets --shadow-card to none. Surfaces are flat; depth comes from 1px Ink rules.

shadows.name: hover-hairline
shadows.purpose: Card hover and input focus: the Ink border turns teal and doubles in weight. Zero blur, no lift, no glow.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default for every UI transition and entrance.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Only for things that move across the screen.

motion.name: transition-fast
motion.purpose: Color, border and underline state changes.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: One-shot scroll entrance; removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The single filled coral control in a view. Uppercase, tracked, square.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.85rem 2rem; font-family: 'Inter Tight', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--bg-primary, #101a18); background: var(--accent-signal, #ff8a65); border: 0; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: scale 120ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.92; } .ds-btn-primary:active { scale: 0.97; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-start, #56c7b2); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Ruled Card
components.description: Transparent, square box outlined in Ink. Shows the page ground.
components.html:
Client project

One line on the work and the outcome.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 1.5rem; background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--text-primary, #f2f6f1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; } .ds-card h3 { font-family: 'Inter Tight', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.03em; line-height: 1.2; color: var(--text-primary, #f2f6f1); margin: 0 0 0.5rem; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.7; letter-spacing: -0.005em; color: var(--text-secondary, #c3d0ca); }

components.name: Skill Pill
components.description: Square, Ink-outlined tag. Not a pill on the Swiss design.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-block; padding: 0.4rem 1rem; font-family: 'Inter Tight', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-secondary, #c3d0ca); background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--text-primary, #f2f6f1); border-radius: 0; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Small tracked caps with a teal underline that grows in on hover.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; font-family: 'Inter Tight', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-secondary, #c3d0ca); text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: -4px; width: 0; height: 2px; background: var(--accent-text, #68d2bd); transition: width 250ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { color: var(--text-primary, #f2f6f1); } .ds-nav-link:hover::after, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible::after { width: 100%; }

components.name: Section Header
components.description: Ink rule on top, coral numeral in the right margin, tracked-caps label, headline title.
components.css: .ds-section { position: relative; padding-top: 4rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--text-primary, #f2f6f1); } .ds-section-num { position: absolute; top: 1rem; right: 1.5rem; font-family: 'Inter Tight', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(3rem, 8vw, 7rem); font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.05em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--accent-signal, #ff8a65); pointer-events: none; } .ds-section-label { display: inline-block; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; font-family: 'Inter Tight', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent-text, #68d2bd); } .ds-section h2 { margin: 0; font-family: 'Inter Tight', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4.5rem); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.04em; line-height: 1.2; color: var(--text-primary, #f2f6f1); }

narrative.overview: A transit signage board is a design system that has to be read at a glance by someone who is already moving. That is the brief for a portfolio that a recruiter skims. The page is a strict grid of ruled boxes and large grotesque type, set on mineral surfaces (a deep green-black at night, a pale chalk-green by day), with one coral signal reserved for position and action. Structure comes from lines and from type size, never from decoration.
keyCharacteristics: A strict grid with a 1180px container and 1px full-contrast rules between sections.
One sans family (Inter Tight) at extreme weights and sizes; hierarchy is size and weight, not color.
Zero radius, shadow and gradient at rest on the default design.
Teal carries structure and emphasis; coral marks position and the single action.
A night and a day palette, chosen by system preference on first visit, each held to WCAG AA.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Coral marks where you are (the section numeral) and what to do (the one filled action). It never decorates, never fills a card, and never appears as text on a paragraph.

rules.name: The Ink Rule
rules.body: Structural lines (section tops, card borders, the nav underline) are Ink at 1px, not a tinted grey. The grid is meant to be seen.

rules.name: The Text-Safe Accent Rule
rules.body: Raw teal is for fills, borders and decoration. As text it is the accent-text shade, which clears 4.5:1 on all four surfaces.

rules.name: The Size-Not-Color Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is carried by scale and weight. Headings are Ink; do not use an accent color to make a heading important.

rules.name: The Tracked-Caps Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is for short labels and the action, always tracked open (0.12em to 0.15em). Never uppercase a sentence.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. State is shown with color, underline, or border weight, never with a drop shadow or glow.

dos: Do use the theme variables (var(--text-primary), var(--accent-text), var(--bg-primary)) in every component and demo, never raw hex; the palette is swapped at runtime and the studio reshapes the rest.
Do draw structure with 1px Ink rules and let the section numerals and large type fill the space.
Do keep exactly one filled coral action per view.
Do use accent-text for any accent-colored text, and verify new color pairs against WCAG AA on both palettes.
Do keep every corner square on the default design and state that in new components.
Do use demoPanel and gradientButton from src/components/demos/_styles.ts for demo panels and actions so the active design can reshape them.
donts: Don't use indigo-to-purple gradients, glow, or glass cards (the generic dev-portfolio look).
Don't use SaaS landing-page tropes: a row of vanity metrics or identical icon-over-heading-over-text card grids.
Don't add ornament for its own sake: decorative shapes, stock illustration, or emoji (iOS also turns many text glyphs into colored tiles).
Don't put coral on body text, cards, or secondary buttons; it is the signal and loses meaning if it spreads.
Don't add shadows, blur, gradients, rounded corners, or hover lift to new components on the default design, and don't bring back the base card-hover glow.
Don't set sentences in uppercase or in a second typeface to create emphasis.
Don't let a decorative element carry meaning; the numeral and any icon are aria-hidden and the text stands alone.
